ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, connect the inductor L with an iron core in series with bulb A, and then connect them in parallel with another completely identical bulb B, connected across the two terminals with a sinusoidal AC signal generator as the power supply. By adjusting the knobs on the AC signal generator, the output voltage and the frequency of the signal can be changed. Close switch S, and both lamps A and B light up. Regarding this experiment, which of the following statements is correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: Keeping the output voltage and signal frequency unchanged, after removing the iron core, it is found that lamp A is brighter than before

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the AC signal generator is connected through switch S between the left and right end nodes of the circuit; the upper branch has only bulb B; in the middle branch, bulb A is connected in series with the inductor marked L; therefore the branch where A and L are located and the branch where bulb B is located are connected in parallel across the same AC power supply. Reasoning: The problem states that the inductor L originally has an iron core, and when the iron core is removed, the output voltage and frequency of the AC signal generator are kept unchanged. Looking at the branch where A is located, the resistance of bulb A is connected in series with the inductive reactance of the inductor. Removing the iron core will make the inductance L decrease; when the frequency f is unchanged, the inductive reactance X_L=2πfL decreases accordingly. Therefore the total impedance of branch A decreases. Since this branch is connected in parallel with the power supply, the voltage across its two ends is still kept unchanged by the power supply, so the current in branch A increases. The brightness of bulb A depends on its actual power; the resistance of lamp A is approximately unchanged and the current increases, so the power increases and the brightness becomes brighter.

raw_record.original_question: 如图所示，将带铁芯的电感器L与灯泡A串联，再与另一个完全相同的灯泡B并联，接在以正弦交流信号发生器为电源的两端。闭合开关S后，保持输出电压和信号频率不变，撤去铁芯后，A灯的亮度将如何变化？
raw_record.answer: Keeping the output voltage and signal frequency unchanged, after removing the iron core, it is found that lamp A is brighter than before
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, the AC signal generator is connected through switch S between the left and right end nodes of the circuit; the upper branch has only bulb B; in the middle branch, bulb A is connected in series with the inductor marked L; therefore the branch where A and L are located and the branch where bulb B is located are connected in parallel across the same AC power supply.
Reasoning: The problem states that the inductor L originally has an iron core, and when the iron core is removed, the output voltage and frequency of the AC signal generator are kept unchanged. Looking at the branch where A is located, the resistance of bulb A is connected in series with the inductive reactance of the inductor. Removing the iron core will make the inductance L decrease; when the frequency f is unchanged, the inductive reactance X_L=2πfL decreases accordingly. Therefore the total impedance of branch A decreases. Since this branch is connected in parallel with the power supply, the voltage across its two ends is still kept unchanged by the power supply, so the current in branch A increases. The brightness of bulb A depends on its actual power; the resistance of lamp A is approximately unchanged and the current increases, so the power increases and the brightness becomes brighter.
